statusHistory.note: Fifth entry in the São Carlos batch. San Marin Padaria • Café is a bakery/café/lunch spot at R. Dom Pedro II 1552, Vila Monteiro (Gleba I) — open Monday-Saturday 7am-7pm, Sunday 7am-1pm. Researched via Google Maps (live coordinates confirmed via Chrome, 4.6/433 reviews, R$40-60pp per 57 diners, owner replies personally to reviews), RestaurantGuru (4.6/5, 361 reviews, photos dated as recently as March 2025), Tripadvisor, and the official iFood menu. Google's own menu-highlights data names Bauru Clássico (a classic Brazilian pressed sandwich — roast beef, tomato, melted cheese) and Queijo Quente as the most-ordered items, which lines up with the operator's own 'pf bom' (good prato feito/lunch) framing better than pastry alone would. UGC quoted both ways: a Local Guide's praise calling it 'sem dúvidas, minha padaria favorita' for freshness and warm service, and a separately-sourced specific complaint about noise (a bell that rings constantly, staff talking loudly) and prices the reviewer found a little high for the product — both surfaced rather than only the positive average. No genuine dated event found; Google Maps and Instagram both read as standing-menu content. Reddit search for São Carlos café/padaria discussion again returned no usable r/SaoCarlos threads — same recurring floor gap as the rest of this batch. Hero image is a real March-2025 photo of the venue's own dining terrace and hand-painted 'San Marin' signage, chosen for being clean, on-brand and dynamic (real staff/diners in frame) rather than a generic empty-room shot — no watermark needed removing this time, unusual for this batch. Full six-locale coverage, self-checked sign-off pass done inline in the same session, single coordinator, no subagents, per the operator's standing token-efficiency directive.

Self-checked sign-off: near-tov-police — no bare-name/crowd-consensus opener, honest register, both positive and negative UGC represented, no AI-tell sludge; language-tic-police — checked all six locale bodies for merged paragraphs or dropped sub-headers, none found; near-legal-counsel — the noise/price complaint is a sourced, specifically-attributed consumer observation, not a defamation risk; identifiable staff/diners in the hero photo are incidental to the venue's own promotional image of its own dining room, same tier as prior precedent, no likeness issue; chief editor — shortTitle checked against catalogue, distinct; no internal Near production concepts leaked into any locale. image-police: hero (1200x675, real March-2025 dining-room photo, no overlay to remove) and body image (1080x810, real covered-terrace exterior shot) both viewed directly — clean, in spec, no AI generation. near-video-finder: checked Instagram Reels — same tooling gap as the rest of the São Carlos batch, verdict 'blocked' (product gap). google-discover-audit: hero clears 1200px-wide/300,000px/16:9 cleanly; shortTitle/tagline supportable by sourced material, no over-promise. departamento-de-vai-dar-merda: price range dated and framed as a range, not a headline number; the 'a bit expensive' complaint is retained rather than smoothed over; no internal-discourse leakage found. backlink-pr/affiliate-pr/ad-sales: no natural affiliate moment; São Carlos/USP student-press candidate logged as with the rest of the batch, outreach still frozen.
